summary.text: Mattie Daughtry is the Democratic president of the Maine Senate, representing District 23, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2012 to 2020 before being elected to the Senate in 2020, and she is a former co-owner of Moderation Brewing.

paragraphs.text: Mattie Daughtry, listed by Ballotpedia as Matthea Daughtry, was born in Brunswick, Maine, in 1987.
She received a B.A. in fine and studio arts from Smith College.
Daughtry was the co-owner of Moderation Brewing and also owned a photography and video production business.
Daughtry was first elected to the Maine House of Representatives in 2012, represented District 49, and served until 2020, when she was elected to the Maine State Senate.
The Senate unanimously elected her Senate president on December 4, 2024; at the time she was the youngest woman elected Senate president in Maine's history.
As Senate president, she said "energy prices, health care, housing and property taxes" would be among the issues in the 2025 legislative session.
She served on the Senate Rules Committee in the 2023–2024 and 2025–2026 sessions.
